_readme: Ziyela's seed for 2026: a made-up student, with no real person's data. scripts/write_seed.py writes this file, so run it again rather than editing it.

She is in her fourth year of Mechatronics (4-year) and has passed every course of her first three years except a complementary studies course, so each of her plans leaves an 18-credit complementary slot.
Her plans, their courses and their reasons are the engine's, as onboarding makes them. Her questionnaire answers are Mbali's, which hide the plans without EEE4119F.
As in mbali.json, each key is a table, rows carry no uuids or student_id, and rows that point at other rows use local keys. Her reasons cite no passage, so approving a year again never breaks a link.
fake_account holds her made-up email, which the tests' fake sign-in uses. sage seed never writes it: a real account brings its own email.

course_history.course_name: Linear Algebra & Differential Equations for Engineers

plan_reasons.message: Every plan holds the core courses you still need this year: CML4607F, EEE4022S, EEE4113F, EEE4124C and EEE4125C.
Every plan takes at least 2 of EEE4117F, EEE4118F and EEE4119F.
Every plan takes at least 48 credits from EEE4114F, EEE4117F, EEE4118F, EEE4119F, EEE4120F and HUB4049F.
Every plan comes to at least 156 credits for the year, counting its complementary studies.
Plans with more electives than the rules ask for aren't listed. The handbook allows more, so ask your advisor if you want to add one.
EEE4022S needs one of EEE4114F, EEE4117F, EEE4118F, EEE4119F or EEE4120F, which every plan holds in time.
